title: Activate or deactivate a patient
summary: More actions → Deactivate (or Activate). An inactive patient doesn't show with the «Active only» filter.

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; tapping one opens their record on the right.

steps.title: Open their record
steps.details: Tap the patient in the list. The guide continues once their record is open.

steps.title: Activate / Deactivate
steps.details: Applies as soon as you tap it. Their history and account are kept.
